header.title: Meet the Visionaries Behind Gulf Estates
header.description: Our team is a dynamic group of experienced professionals, each dedicated to delivering exceptional service and expert guidance. With a shared passion for excellence, we are committed to helping you navigate Dubai's luxury real estate market and turn your property aspirations into reality.

ceo.name: Alexandre Photiou
ceo.title: Visionary Entrepreneur & CEO
ceo.bio: A dynamic entrepreneur and CEO, leading Gulf Sea Real Estate LLC, a premier firm specializing in luxury residential and investment properties in the UAE. With a strong track record in high-value real estate, he has built a reputation for delivering exceptional properties and investment opportunities across prime locations. Beyond real estate, his diverse portfolio spans multiple industries, including luxury yacht rentals, logistics, and event management. With a strategic mindset and a passion for innovation, he has successfully expanded businesses catering to high-net-worth individuals across the UAE. His leadership is defined by excellence, operational efficiency, and a client-focused approach, positioning him as a key player in the industry.
